prompt:
Iterate on this full-screen market alarm (急跌·做多 = long, emerald; 急涨·做空 = short, crimson). Keep the dark cinematic look, particle rain, edge glow and the countdown ring at the top-right. Owner requests:
1. The K-line wallpaper is the hero: by default show the first coin's (BTC) 5m candlestick chart spanning the whole screen edge to edge behind everything, clearly visible, not dimmed to near-black. While candles load show a faint candle skeleton/shimmer, never an empty screen.
2. Move the three big numbers (25 币触及, +3 新增, −1.24% BTC) from the left side to the RIGHT side: stacked, right-aligned, under the countdown ring, slightly smaller, with a soft dark gradient behind them so the newest candles (right edge) stay readable.
3. One row of coin chips at the bottom-left: BTC, ETH, then the touched coins (SOL, ADA, AEVO, ... with their depth %). Clicking a chip crossfades the wallpaper chart to that coin; the active chip is highlighted. Merge the touched-coin list into these chips; no duplicate lists.
4. Remove unnecessary text: no status lines or helper text; test alarms only get a tiny '测试' badge.
5. Motion: one entrance burst, count-up numbers, 300ms chart crossfade on coin switch, a pulse on +N when new coins touch; respect reduced motion.
Bottom center keeps: sound, replay history, primary '知道了' button, open 1.618 page.
Show a desktop 1440x900 frame and a mobile 390x844 frame. All numbers and coins are placeholders.
